context: Tests whether the agent gives feedback on the draft without changing the file: strong passages quoted with reasons, problems located and explained, direction rather than rewrite, and a whole-piece assessment.

checklist.name: File unchanged
checklist.description: draft.md is byte-for-byte what it was at the start, and no edited copy of it was written to the workspace.

checklist.name: Strongest passages quoted
checklist.description: The feedback quotes at least one of the strong passages directly, such as the Dana migration opening or 'The timer lasted two weeks. The rule about calling time lasted.', and says why it works.

checklist.name: Problems located and explained
checklist.description: The feedback names specific weak spots, such as the 'it is important to note' paragraph, the vague bulleted list, the emoji, or the generic conclusion, says where each is, and says why it fails.

checklist.name: Direction, not a rewrite
checklist.description: For the problems it names, the feedback points a direction such as cut, tighten, or add specifics. It does not supply replacement text for the weak paragraphs or a rewritten draft.

checklist.name: Whole-piece assessment
checklist.description: The feedback assesses the piece as a whole: whether the structure serves the point, how the opening and ending land, and whether it is the right length.
